description: Unmute authors on an alert without touching the rest of its filter. Name each by the stored entry or any link to that profile or its posts; authors that are not muted are ignored.

inputSchema.description: Authors to add to or remove from the alert's muted list.

authors.description: Profile or post links (x.com/name, linkedin.com/in/name, reddit.com/user/name, a post URL), handles (@name, u/name), Bluesky DIDs or display names. A link is stored as the author's profile; a plain name or handle matches that name on every platform.

name: unmute_authors
title: Unmute authors
